text:
emily: Quick post-all-hands ask: can we lock down three tiny items for the notes so PM/docs can ship guidance? 1) Which sprint for sparse-attn vs quant-kernels? 2) Hosted KV eviction default now? 3) One-line conservative batching defaults for Hosted vs Dedicated + owner/ETA. Keep replies clipped. @sam @raj @kevin
sam: Sparse-attn is in this sprint but gated on a correctness test; quant kick-off is next sprint.
raj: Hosted KV eviction: LRU by default; weighted variants are experimental opt-ins.
kevin: Ops: watch p95 token latency, p99, kernel_error_rate, kv_evictions/sec. I'll wire an automated abort if kernel_error_rate > 0.8% within 10m.
dina: PM wants a paste-ready YAML block for docs and a single-line cost delta for batch_ms 10->25. Can infra/bench help?
leo: I'll run a quick sweep and post a tiny table (p50/p95/p99 + approx cost %) tomorrow AM.
sam: Paste-ready conservative YAML: 
```
runtime_defaults:
  batching:
    batch_ms: 12
    max_batch_tokens: 4096
    adaptive: true
  kv_cache:
    policy: LRU
    ttl_seconds: 0
  prewarm:
    enabled: false
    window_ms: 1000
```
maria: Owners/ETA for notes: Sam (kernel timing) EOD, Leo (perf CSV) Tue AM, Raj (Dedicated sizing) Thu. Dina will own doc publication.
canary-bot: canary-plan: kernel-v11 canary window 2026-04-15T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-15T04:00:00Z. Gating: CI perf green + smoke.
emily: Great 97 please paste a 2-line summary here with owners and I'll add to #all-hands-notes. If you want to be removed from follow-ups say so now.
sam: Will post the 2-line summary by EOD.
